page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is a virtualized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 4 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 23.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.75 GB per core. For acceleration, it includes a fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU (0.25x allocation) with 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that this instance sits in the lower performance tiers for both compute and memory operations. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests yielded weak results of 1103.98 and 2934.21 respectively, while the Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores registered in the bottom 10% at 904.0 and 2011.0. Memory performance is similarly constrained, with large-block read bandwidth falling into the poor category at 19.82 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the instance achieved 233.71 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model, and static web serving throughput reached 3.32 GB/sec.

Given its fractional GPU configuration, this instance offers a cost-efficient entry point for workloads requiring GPU acceleration without the expense of a dedicated full GPU. However, the trade-off is lower CPU and memory performance. It is best suited for lightweight GPU-accelerated tasks, entry-level machine learning inference, basic image processing, or development and testing environments where a full GPU is not resource-efficient.
